releaseNotes:
1. Multi-Marker Selection Mode: Tap 'Select Markers' in feeder context menu to select individual or multiple tower markers with compact checkboxes, sticky top toolbar, Select All, and Clear Selection.
2. Copy & Move to Feeder: Transfer selected towers with complete SQLite transaction safety, independent database IDs for copied records, and dynamic line geometry recalculation.
3. Automatic Sequence Merging: Transferred towers naturally merge into their numerical sequence without appending to the end.
4. TANTRANSCO Tower Parsing & Tension Sorting: Full support for numeric, alphabetic (31A, 79A), tension point 'T' (4T, 8T, 12T), and slash-separated formats (10/1, 10/1T, 10/2, 10/3, 10/3T, 10/4). Tension point towers appear immediately after normal towers with [T] badge and 'TENSION' tower_type.
5. Duplicate Location Conflict Handling: Geographical conflict warnings with Keep Both Towers, Cancel Transfer, and Review Both on Map options.
6. UI & Safe Scrolling Fixes: Resolved container decoration assertions and wrapped drawer bottom sheets in scroll-safe containers.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Feeder Row Auto-Resize: Feeder names wrap automatically onto multiple lines without height clipping, and Tower Count remains always visible below the title for both Tamil and English feeders.
2. Tower Marker Drag & Drop: Long-press any tower marker to enter Move Mode and drag to reposition. Automatically updates coordinates in SQLite database and refreshes feeder lines.
3. Safe Feeder Association: Guaranteed tower isolation across different feeders using stable composite identifiers.
4. Feeder Line Geometry & Distance Sync: Polyline vertices and cumulative transmission-line distances update dynamically when a tower moves.
5. Move Undo Support: One-tap 'UNDO' action in confirmation toast restores original database coordinates and polyline geometry.
6. KMZ / KML Export Compatibility: Coordinate modifications are preserved in database and exported KMZ/KML packages without corrupting source files.
